title: Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi Hurricane Harvey Response
description: Coast Guard members from Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi describe response efforts to Hurricane Harvey which hit the Texas coast on August 25, 2017. Through proper planning, dedication to duty and coordination with federal, state and local partners members of Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi responded to the first major hurricane to hit the U.S. in more than a decade. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Johanna Strickland.
keywords: Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi, Hurricane Harvey

transcript.text: In any kind of event like this, you have to rely on proper plans, plans and exercises.

What we had down here was some search and rescue.

And then thirdly making sure that there aren't any submerged vessels.

Just the flexibility and the amount of preparedness that my people had during this emergent operation.
Certainly a lot of things impress me from the crew themselves.
The crew's resiliency and the crew's willingness and ability to react so quickly was a little

They're phenomenal folks.

When natural disaster strikes they come to the forefront.

You know just the fact that there was three back to back and the fact that we got out there

Harvey shaped the response for the Coast Guard.
